prompt:
The attached image is the authoritative Loopforge character concept. Isolate and develop the EXACT robot on the FAR RIGHT FOREGROUND, the one POINTING HIS INDEX FINGER to the left while scolding the others. This specific character, with its actual shape and proportions, is the request. Do not substitute a generic slim worker or redesign him into a standard blue game robot.

Create a single full-body CHARACTER PORTRAIT of that exact pointing right-side robot, in the SAME three-quarter left-facing stance and pointing gesture as the source. Preserve the distinctive long swept-back dome/skull, pronounced sloped forehead over the narrow bright cyan eye slit, mechanical skeletal grin, deep cheek cutouts and protruding lower jaw. Preserve the huge circular ear receiver tucked into the side of the skull, layered hoses along back of head/neck, hunched forward head position, broad rounded overlapping shoulder cap, layered chest/side plate construction, the scuffed hinged forearm panels, long mechanical index finger and fist of other fingers in the accusing hand. The lower hand stays down and relaxed, as in the reference. This fellow looks like a petty factory official who has just found something to object to; his exact body language matters.

Closely copy the original design language and visible details: aged riveted plates, pale distressed armor edges over dark steel, dirty oily exposed mechanisms, ribbed conduits, small utilitarian square chest nameplate left BLANK, articulated waist. Keep the broad upper back and projecting shoulder shell with a narrower lower torso, not a skinny soldier with tapered clean armor or superhero chest. Complete unseen lower legs and boots consistently with the source's densely built industrial joints. Keep him visibly smaller and less decorated than LIMEN, but a robot goon with authority in his bearing.

Paint finish should retain the original worn grimy steel quality, with dark muted navy-blue enamel on large outer plates so he fits the worker cast; do not replace it with bright uniform blue. No new chevron, racing stripe, white chest band or invented costume. No weapon or new accessory. Background becomes plain dark charcoal smoky studio, all other characters, desk, pipes and text removed. Full body top to soles, careful grounded feet and anatomically coherent fingers. Match the illustrated dark industrial realism and distinctive right-hand figure faithfully. Only one figure, no inset, no labels. This is an identity portrait for approval; NOT a generic neutral A-pose yet.
